content.text: Despite being the defending champion, Xander Schauffele acknowledges that his performance has not been great due to a rib injury he sustained at the beginning of the season, even though he ended up tied with Scheffler at nine-under par in last week's Scottish Open.

As Lowry prepared for the 2019 Open, he had good reason to feel optimistic, having secured a victory in Abu Dhabi earlier that year, followed by a period of solid form. However, he was also aware that the week could prove to be difficult on his home turf.

With 156 players vying for the Claret Jug and the title of 'Champion Golfer of the Year', the defending champion is American Xander Schauffele. The last time the championship was held at Portrush in 2019, Ireland's Shane Lowry claimed the title.
